title: Code for: Reconstruction of Global Groundwater Storage Anomaly from GRACE Satellite Gravimetry Using a Physics-Constrained Decomposition LSTM
description: Python pipeline that isolates groundwater from GRACE/GRACE-FO total water storage, reconstructs monthly 0.5-degree groundwater storage anomalies (April 2002 to December 2022) with a physics-constrained decomposition LSTM, validates them against the GROW well network, WaterGAP 2.2d and GRACE-SeDA, decomposes trend uncertainty, and derives sea-level and polar-motion consequences.
